impact.text: Traders, especially algorithmic ones using round numbers, will encounter unexplained failures.

precondition_sources.text: A limit order matching (partial or full) is being processed in _processLimitBidOrder or _processLimitAskOrder.
The matched base amount is a power-of-two value 2^k.
The matched quote amount is any value less than 2^k (e.g., base = 256, quote in 1..255).
The two matched amounts have no overlapping 1-bits (e.g., 40 & 21 = 0).

intent_sources.text: The zero-cost trade check must reject only trades where one side receives tokens without sending any, not legitimate trades whose amounts have disjoint bits.
